title: Home Sales in Central Texas Completely FLIPPED
description:
Everybody wants to talk about “the market.” The market is not what decides your check at closing.

Here’s the part nobody explains in Killeen. Your list price is not your take-home price. List price is the bait that gets buyers in the door. What you actually walk away with comes down to how you’re positioned, what you concede, and every line item at the closing table.

Price too high and buyers scroll past. The longer it sits, the more you end up giving back. Price it right and buyers compete, and that competition is what protects your equity.

It’s not your fault if nobody broke this down before. The industry loves a big list price. I care about the number that hits your account.
Want to see where your home should actually start?
